messages:
Elle K.: quick design sync  about run-history + tool-calling microcopy. noticed a bunch of small inconsistencies on staging.

Marc D.: shoot the top items and I can patch.

Elle K.: 1) verbs: left action says 'Open' in one place and 'View' elsewhere. makes behavior unclear. propose 'Expand run' for the chevron and 'Open replay' for the play icon.

Sam (PM): agree. distinct verbs map to distinct affordances.

Elle K.: 2) run summary reads like code (eg `summarizeText(...)`). suggest human pills: 'Summarize  long  short  2 args'. use ellipsis on narrow view and full copy in aria-label.

Marc D.: implementation note: keep pill visible as a button with role=button and aria-label. add text-overflow: ellipsis.

Elle K.: 3) errors: replace raw stack dump with calm line 'Tool failed  retry or inspect details' and a secondary 'Show error details' control. include invocation id.

Sam (PM): can we also surface 'Signature changed: +N' when function schema diffs occur? helpful for QA.

Marc D.: yes we already log diffs. UI can show a small banner with icon + neutral bg. ensure contrast and aria-live="polite".

Elle K.: a11y nits: toggles must be buttons with aria-expanded; keyboard nav (j/k) to move between runs but disabled while inputs focused; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Marc D.: will patch toggles, add aria-expanded, wire j/k and reduced-motion.

deploy-bot: Deployed run-history copy + a11y tweaks to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/playground (build #2026.4.8) :rocket:

Sam (PM): thanks! I'll add the new copy to release notes and update QA checklist.

Elle K.: small follow-up: ensure the schema-preview tooltip opens on Enter/Space and limits preview to top 3 fields. I'll add updated Figma notes later.
